command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj RV-P4-beq-btype.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `beq a0, a1, 8` / `addi a0, a1, 1` / `beq a0, a1, -8`. The two branches are PC-relative at offsets 0 and 8, so the second targets offset 0. The plan states the same bytes through two `scale` fixups with `transform_shift: 1`, which is the field-content rule of 07_definition_format.md §8.3. Both fixups use `resolve_in_place`, so no relocation record is emitted and `records` is 0, as in A64-P5.
